execute.description: Create proof records with a positive safe integer check
execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE proof_records (
            id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            label TEXT NOT NULL,
            amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount) = 'integer' AND amount BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991)
          )

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AS result FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'proof_records'
